Moss's 30 September strategic digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted ticket #8841 for Door 14 at Newark. Drivers on the second shift couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July, in #strategic-pod, you wrote that you'd closed out ticket #8841 with support. That was about the Detention Summary CSV export and the kiosk tablet cache issue. The same number can't easily be both, so either the digest or that earlier message has the wrong ticket number. Look up #8841 in the support system to confirm it's the Door 14 ticket. I can't see that system.
